contract.variant: Standing two-hand horns-grip kettlebell halo, alternating directions
contract.counting: Each full circle is one repetition; loop shows two circles
contract.phases: Front reset with base up; first side with base rearward; rear with base down and elbows raised; other side with base rearward; front reset; reverse direction
contract.contacts: Feet planted; head and torso steady; palms wrap opposite horns continuously; straight wrists; the bell rotates in the hands without detaching
contract.camera: Fixed three-quarter upper-body crop; planted feet remain constrained outside crop
contract.timing: 128 frames at 16 fps; eight-second loop with brief front resets
